questions.question: Hello and welcome! Could you please introduce yourself and share what attracted you to the Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer role at TechVision Labs?
Walk me through a project you recently worked on that you are particularly proud of. What was your core contribution?
What are your availability timelines for joining, and what are your primary career goals over the next two years?
In the context of Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer, how do you design systems to handle high concurrency while preventing race conditions and bottlenecks?
Could you discuss how you would architect a modern web application utilizing TypeScript and React? What architectural trade-offs do you consider?
Can you describe a challenging production bug or outage you diagnosed in the past? What debugging process did you employ?

transcript.text: Welcome Alex! Could you tell me a little bit about yourself and what excites you about this AI Engineer role?

transcript.text: Hello! I have spent the last 5 years designing full-stack web platforms and recently specialized in integrating generative AI agents. What excites me about TechVision Labs is the focus on low-latency interactive AI interfaces.

transcript.text: That sounds impressive. In terms of technical architecture, how do you handle streaming responses from an LLM while maintaining state consistency in React?

transcript.text: I focus on objective metrics—such as latency benchmarks, testability, and development speed—and document an RFC so the entire squad aligns transparently.
